quotes.text: We did the snorkeling and dolphin watch combo trip. Really nice modern catamaran with stairs that drop right down in the middle to get in the water! The captain and mates were all very nice and helpful. The snorkel gear was new, clean and worked well. The snorkeling was great we saw a variety of fish at the reef. After snorkeling we saw a huge pod of dolphins. Was very neat! We even saw a big sea turtle!

The crew members (sarah, nico, john, and captain Chuck) all made us feel really welcome and at home on the boat. They explained boat safety well and the trip was excellent ! I felt like I was in a party boat. The guided kayaking/paddle board tour was amazing as well. My family and I love this so much we actually went back again two days in a row! definitely suggest doing an activity through them.

Our family came to Key West for our vacation in October! First thing we did was the Triple cruise. Snorkeling, Dolphins and Sunset! Captain Kyle and his crew were amazing. We boarded the Miss Lora for our adventure and they were the nicest ever! The dolphins gave us an amazing show and our 6 year old granddaughter was in heaven watching. Thank you Captain Kyle for a great time!

We woke up to find out another tour we had booked cancelled so our resort offered this trip last minute "ultimate sandbar tour" and we were happy to be able to be out on the water. The captain chuck and his two crew were great! The wind was pretty strong so our kayak trip was difficult but we all made it back safe! Super fun day out!

Best jetski Tour Everrrr!!! Morgan was our tour guide and he was awesome! The knowledge he passed on made us feel comfortable and safe for our first time. He was very knowledgeable of the area and the conditions of the water. Morgan made our time on tour amazing with his kind heart! I will definitely come again because of him!!!

Johnny was a godsend in getting us hooked up with a 6 seater golf cart for us to use. We ran every drop of gas out of it from adventuring. We were 10 min from the harbor, Mallory Square, Duval street, and plenty of restaurants. He also helped us in booking the Dolphin and snorkel tour and it was such a fun adventure.
